name: 08822 · Flemington, NJ
findings: ZIP 08822 (Flemington) has 150 nonprofit organizations. 84 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 66 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08822 (Flemington) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
